content: llama.cpp ggml-cuda/HIP backend: per-op dispatch functions (ggml_cuda_mul_mat) select kernel path by tensor type + device capability: MMQ quantized kernels vs hipBLAS GEMM for prefill, mul_mat_vec_q for decode M<=8; ops organized as one file per op family (.cu/.cuh compiled via HIP); ggml_cuda_op template handles H2D copy/dequant/broadcast; recent refactor discussion #22975 splits monolith into device.cu/buffer.cu/graph.cu/mul-mat.cu/compute-forward.cu/fusion.cu/registry.cu. Adding a custom kernel = add .cu file + selection hook in dispatch function; minimal patch surface.
